name_zh: 有机现代庭院咖啡空间
trigger: Calm cafes, adaptive reuse, garden restaurants, hospitality interiors, indoor-outdoor threshold concepts.
not_for: Plush luxury hotels, maximalist retail, futuristic labs, tiny product close-ups.
visual_dna: A mature tree is the spatial anchor; rough masonry and microcement meet aged timber, blackened metal, terrazzo and cane; overhead slats modulate daylight; circulation dissolves around a courtyard.
composition_light_color_material: Wide eye-level architectural view; foreground threshold frames a deep sequence; one-point or restrained two-point perspective; hard daylight softened through beams and foliage; charcoal, brick, weathered wood, river stone and muted green.
boundaries: Tree and path must affect the plan, not decorate a corner. Keep furniture low and sparse. Use a 50/30/20 material hierarchy: quiet primary surfaces, warm natural accents, precise metal/glass details.
template: An organic-modern [CAFE / HOSPITALITY SPACE] organized around one mature living tree in an interior courtyard, layered threshold from street to counter to garden, rough microcement and dark brick primary surfaces, aged timber ceiling beams, black terrazzo service counter, cane-and-wood furniture, river-stone tree bed and precise glass partitions, wide eye-level architectural photograph, sunlight filtered through slatted roof and foliage, calm earthy palette, deep spatial clarity, no people posing, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Random potted plants; fake moss on every wall; glossy shopping-mall finishes; furniture showroom symmetry; tree with no root zone; harsh HDR.

trigger: Boutique hotel rooms, private cabins, premium lounges, restrained residential luxury and material mood studies.
not_for: Bright Scandinavian catalogues, family playrooms, white-background ecommerce, wide real-estate documentation.
visual_dna: Luxury communicated by light on material rather than object count; amber side light cuts long graphic shadows; polished wood, brass, leather and linen reflect at different strengths; dark negative space creates intimacy.
composition_light_color_material: Close architectural vignette or sparse wide room; low-key exposure; warm hard side light from one believable opening; mahogany, tobacco, brass, navy and warm linen; deep reflections kept below clipping.
boundaries: One dominant light source. Two premium material families plus a textile are enough. Let darkness remain dark. No decorative object pile or chandelier-as-proof-of-luxury.
template: A cinematic interior photograph of [LUXURY SPACE], composed as a restrained architectural vignette, one warm low-angle side light casting long geometric shadows across [WOOD / STONE / LEATHER], controlled reflections on polished surfaces, accents of aged brass and tactile linen, deep tobacco and navy shadows, sparse furnishings, quiet private atmosphere, realistic low-key exposure, subtle 35mm character, no people, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Orange color wash over everything; blown windows; dozens of gold objects; flat ceiling light; hotel-catalogue staging; excessive bloom.

name_zh: 复古未来海滨度假空间
trigger: Fashion editorials, dream hotels, coastal architecture, elegant travel narratives and quiet near-future lifestyle worlds.
not_for: Cyberpunk streets, rustic cabins, crowded family resorts, hard industrial sci-fi.
visual_dna: 1960s resort optimism filtered through a near-future lens; white stone, peach plaster, chrome and glass; arches and sweeping curves; sea horizon as an architectural datum; elegant human scale and intentional emptiness.
composition_light_color_material: Square or 5:4 editorial frame; long axis toward water; wide negative sky or reflective floor; hard clean Mediterranean day, honey sunset or cyan pool night; white, turquoise, coral, pale gold and deep teal.
boundaries: Keep technology implicit in form and finish. Use one or two people at most. Preserve a clear horizon. Avoid spaceships, HUD graphics and generic neon-city signals.
template: A quiet retro-futurist seaside [HOTEL / RESORT SPACE], 1960s modernist optimism with near-future precision, sweeping white and pale-coral arches, chrome details, glass walls and a clear turquoise sea horizon, one elegant [TRAVELER] used only for scale, generous negative space, [CLEAN DAYLIGHT / HONEY SUNSET / CYAN POOL NIGHT], polished stone reflections, calm premium editorial photography, square or 5:4 frame, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Blade Runner neon; spaceship furniture; crowds; random palm-tree wallpaper; kitschy atomic-age props; oversaturated tropical postcard color.

trigger: Magazine covers, cultural portraits, fashion editorials, identity campaigns and concept-led profile art.
not_for: Clean ecommerce, documentary portraits, children's illustration, literal diagrams.
visual_dna: Recognizable portrait interrupted by tactile paper planes, architectural grids or dissolving blocks; analog tear edges meet precise editorial geometry; a restrained neutral field keeps fragmentation legible.
composition_light_color_material: Tight portrait or three-figure horizontal; subject remains the anchor; layers cross but do not erase eyes and gesture; soft editorial light; ivory, charcoal, ochre, muted olive and one accent; torn paper, pencil construction, printed photo and matte plaster fragments.
boundaries: Use two collage mechanisms maximum. Preserve identity and silhouette. Give fragments a directional logic. Typography is a separate overlay zone, not random microtext.
template: A premium deconstructed editorial collage of [SUBJECT], identity and expression clearly preserved while [TORN PAPER PLANES / ARCHITECTURAL GRID / DISSOLVING BLOCKS] pass through selected edges, layered printed photography, matte paper fibers, pencil construction lines and restrained geometric marks on a warm neutral field, soft editorial lighting, palette of ivory charcoal ochre muted olive and one [ACCENT], deliberate asymmetry and clear negative space, no invented text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Covering both eyes; every collage effect at once; random stickers; scrapbook clutter; saturated rainbow pieces; broken anatomy mistaken for collage.

trigger: Album art, festival covers, expressive wallpapers, music visualization and energetic identity fields.
not_for: Corporate reports, restrained luxury, precise diagrams, narrative character art.
visual_dna: One continuous force field—vortex, glossy flow or radial mandala—rather than scattered shapes; high chroma held together by a dominant motion; tactile paint or polished resin; image works without text.
composition_light_color_material: Square/vertical cover; central vortex, radial symmetry or sweeping S-curve; edge-to-edge image; three dominant hues plus a small metallic/light accent; oil impasto, viscous glossy resin or fine fractal filigree.
boundaries: Choose exactly one motion grammar and one material. Maintain a calm focal center or clean title zone. Keep black/neutral separation so color does not become visual noise.
template: An abstract psychedelic cover driven by one [VORTEX / RADIAL MANDALA / FLOWING S-CURVE], edge-to-edge [OIL IMPASTO / ULTRA-GLOSSY RESIN / FINE FRACTAL FILIGREE], dominant palette of [COLOR 1], [COLOR 2] and [COLOR 3] with restrained [METALLIC / LIGHT] accents, strong directional rhythm, deep color separation, one calm focal center or reserved title zone, square album-art composition, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Unrelated floating blobs; every rainbow hue at equal weight; no focal rhythm; prompt mixing oil, glass and watercolor; decorative AI noise; automatic fake album title.

trigger: Futuristic profile art, technology campaign objects, music visuals, symbolic animals and sculptural brand imagery.
not_for: Soft beauty portraits, realistic wildlife, architecture documentation, friendly children's characters.
visual_dna: Subject reconstructed from interlocking angular planes; profile or motion silhouette remains instantly recognizable; dark void isolates the sculpture; iridescent metal catches cyan, violet, magenta and amber edge light.
composition_light_color_material: Centered floating bust/object or dynamic full-body animal; three-quarter/profile view; hard rim lights from opposing hues; deep purple-blue gradient void; brushed and anodized metal with crisp bevels; minimal ground or none.
boundaries: Preserve the subject's primary silhouette. Use large intentional facets, not low-poly noise. Keep one spiral/curve counterform at most. Materials stay metallic rather than plastic.
template: A sculptural neo-cubist interpretation of [SUBJECT], recognizable [PROFILE / ACTION] rebuilt from large interlocking metallic planes and sharp geometric wedges, floating against a dark purple-blue gradient void, brushed and anodized metal with crisp bevels, opposing cyan-violet and amber-magenta rim lights, dramatic three-quarter composition, a few controlled curved counterforms, premium 3D studio render, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Uniform tiny triangles; melted chrome; rainbow plastic; lost silhouette; busy environment; low-poly game asset look.

trigger: Cozy children's book scenes, gentle family stories, cottages, gardens, animal friendships, nostalgic everyday adventures.
not_for: Hard sci-fi, horror, glossy advertising, photorealism, action scenes that need sharp impact.
visual_dna: Hand-inked contours with uneven pressure; transparent watercolor washes; tiny story-carrying props; rounded, friendly silhouettes; tactile off-white paper; calm, humane observation.
composition_light_color_material: Wide establishing view or readable medium-wide tableau; foreground plants frame a clear path to the subject; soft daylight; sky blue, moss green, wheat, terracotta and muted flower accents; watercolor bloom, pencil hatching and visible paper grain.
boundaries: Keep one main action and one secondary discovery. Preserve breathing room. Faces stay simple and expressive. Texture must read as physical media, never as glossy 3D.
template: A cozy hand-illustrated children's picture-book scene of [SUBJECT] [ACTION] in [PLACE], one clear visual story with small discoverable details, friendly rounded shapes, delicate ink contours, transparent watercolor and colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft natural daylight, muted sky-blue moss-green wheat and terracotta palette, wide readable composition, gentle nostalgic mood, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Generic anime eyes; hyper-detailed pores; oversaturated rainbow palette; flat vector fills; empty wallpaper composition; random decorative clutter with no story function.

trigger: Rainy city stories, quiet magical encounters, retro-future streets, melancholic urban characters, anime establishing shots.
not_for: Flat character sheets, cheerful kawaii icons, daylight product art, text-heavy posters.
visual_dna: Drawn anime characters embedded in a richly observed city; wet asphalt and practical signage; cool ambient blue opposed by warm windows or neon; atmospheric depth; a single narrative anomaly or emotional anchor.
composition_light_color_material: Street-level wide or medium-wide frame; converging streets pull the eye inward; foreground subject occupies less than half the frame; rain, bloom and reflected light; inked animation contours over painterly backgrounds; blue-violet base with amber, cyan or magenta accents.
boundaries: The environment must carry at least half the story. Use one hero color contrast. Signage is atmospheric shape, not legible copy. Keep anatomy and perspective grounded.
template: A cinematic anime film still of [CHARACTER] [ACTION] on [CITY STREET] at night, richly observed architecture and shopfronts, wet pavement reflections, cool blue-hour ambient light contrasted with warm practical windows and restrained [ACCENT COLOR] neon, atmospheric rain or mist, painterly background with clean 2D character linework, street-level [SHOT], deep environmental storytelling, one subtle magical or emotional focal point, no readable text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Character floating over a generic blurred background; every surface glowing neon; random Japanese text; excessive lens flare; game UI; chibi proportions.

trigger: Product explainers, onboarding illustrations, blog headers, lightweight workplace stories, friendly avatars and concept metaphors.
not_for: Dramatic realism, luxury campaigns, painterly landscapes, detailed technical diagrams.
visual_dna: Crisp black monoline with slight hand-drawn warmth; simplified anatomy; very sparse fills; white field as an active design element; one readable gesture; editorial restraint.
composition_light_color_material: One full-body or medium-shot subject; large negative space; orthographic or eye-level view; no modeled lighting; black and white with at most one muted accent; clean vector-like stroke on white.
boundaries: Preserve silhouette clarity at thumbnail size. Limit props to what explains the action. Avoid cross-hatching and gradients. Use diversity through pose and clothing, not facial detail.
template: A minimalist editorial line-art illustration of [SUBJECT] [ACTION], one instantly readable gesture, simplified friendly anatomy, crisp slightly imperfect black monoline, sparse black fills, pure white background with generous negative space, eye-level flat composition, at most one muted [ACCENT COLOR] detail, modern knowledge-product aesthetic, no shadows, no gradients, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Dense scenery; photoreal face; thick comic outlines; emoji-like icons; random decoration; multiple competing actions.

trigger: Humorous social scenes, dramatic reactions, event art, retro campaign visuals, energetic group storytelling.
not_for: Quiet elegance, subtle luxury, factual diagrams, photoreal portraits.
visual_dna: Bold black contour; Ben-Day halftone dots; simplified high-chroma blocks; exaggerated expressions; speech-burst geometry; theatrical snapshot storytelling.
composition_light_color_material: Single decisive panel; diagonal action or tightly staged group; flat high-key lighting; cyan, yellow, magenta, red and black; screen-print misregistration and aged paper edge may be subtle.
boundaries: Use one emotional beat. Text bubbles are optional placeholders and should be omitted unless exact copy is provided. Maintain clear foreground/background separation.
template: A single-panel 1960s pop-comic illustration of [SUBJECTS] during [DRAMATIC OR FUNNY MOMENT], exaggerated readable expressions and gestures, bold black ink contours, Ben-Day halftone dots, flat high-chroma cyan yellow magenta red palette, dynamic [COMPOSITION], crisp screen-print texture, strong silhouette hierarchy, optional empty speech-burst shape only, no invented words, no logo.
anti_patterns: Thin anime linework; realistic skin shading; muddy color; multiple unreadable panels; AI gibberish text; cinematic depth of field.

pilot_note: A directional welcome-page trial favored this card's tactile material rules, but the card remains generation-pending.
trigger: Cute mascots, stop-motion characters, educational animals, tactile collectible figures, gentle miniature storytelling.
not_for: Fast action, polished metal products, realistic humans, large environments.
visual_dna: Finger-shaped matte volume; deliberately simplified proportions; oversized eyes or one strong facial cue; tiny tool marks; physically plausible contact and weight; warm handmade charm.
composition_light_color_material: Centered full-body figure or small group; eye-level or slight high angle; large softbox light; shallow depth of field only when an environment exists; clay, ceramic or felt-like surface; restrained earthy/pastel palette.
boundaries: Choose one primary handmade material and keep it consistent. Preserve small imperfections without making the object dirty. Background stays simple enough to reveal silhouette.
template: A handcrafted stop-motion-style [SUBJECT] made from matte kneaded clay, [POSE OR ACTION], simplified rounded proportions, expressive oversized [FACIAL FEATURE], visible subtle fingerprints and sculpting marks, physically believable weight and contact, centered full-body composition, soft diffused studio light, restrained [EARTHY OR PASTEL] palette, simple tactile backdrop, charming but not childish, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Perfect glossy plastic; mixed materials on every body part; floating feet; hyperreal fur; crowded toy shelf; generic Pixar imitation.

names: 荒野黄金时刻电影风景 / Golden-Hour Cinematic Wilderness
trigger: 用户需要山地、旷野、湖泊、乡间道路或自然旅行画面呈现安静、辽阔、可进入的电影感。
not_for: 产品广告、城市地标海报、奇幻巨构、需要人物占据主要画面的任务。
visual_dna: 地形和光共同讲故事；前景提供可触摸的自然纹理，中景形成路径，低角度暖光穿过薄雾，把视线带向远处，而不是依靠夸张天空制造震撼。
composition_light_color_material: 宽画幅或竖幅远景；三分构图；前、中、远三层清楚；暖金光与略冷阴影；岩石、草地、水面和空气透视保留真实细节。
boundaries: 可替换地貌、季节、天气和写实或轻绘画媒介；必须保持自然地形为主体、单一低角度光源、可读空间层次和克制色彩。若城市、产品或巨型角色成为最高对比主体，应改用其他卡。
anti_patterns: 全图橙黄、假 HDR 光晕、太阳正中、云层抢主体、所有景物同等锐利、随意加入人物或建筑、只有壁纸感而没有通向远方的视觉路径。
name_zh: 荒野黄金时刻电影风景
template: Cinematic wilderness landscape of {NATURAL LOCATION}, a tactile foreground of {ROCK / GRASS / WATER / WILDFLOWERS} leading through a readable midground path toward {DISTANT LANDFORM}, low golden-hour light entering from one side, restrained warm highlights and slightly cool shadows, thin atmospheric haze separating three depth layers, believable geology and vegetation, calm expansive mood, no hero product, no oversized figure, no text, no orange wash, no artificial HDR halo.

names: 雨夜复古霓虹城市 / Retro Neon Rain City
trigger: 用户需要雨夜街道、音乐视觉、电影环境或复古未来城市呈现潮湿、孤独、霓虹驱动的都市氛围。
not_for: 人物肖像、明亮商业街纪实、白天城市规划图、要求准确复刻现实店招和建筑的任务。
visual_dna: 城市环境而非人物是主角；一到两组霓虹色通过湿路、玻璃和薄雾反复出现，深色建筑和街道形成安静的负空间，少量车辆或行人只负责尺度和叙事。
composition_light_color_material: 街面或小巷的宽景；青绿、洋红或钨丝暖色组成受控互补色；雨水在沥青上形成纵深反射；远处标牌逐渐虚化，黑位仍保留建筑层次。
boundaries: 可替换年代、城市、车辆和行人；必须保持城市环境占主导、湿表面响应、有限霓虹色、深浅空间层次。若人物面部成为焦点，改用霓虹人像卡；若满画面飞车和义体成为核心，改用赛博科幻卡。
anti_patterns: 每块墙都塞满招牌、红蓝机械对半、所有颜色饱和到顶、路面像镜子、乱码文字占据主体、随意增加飞行汽车、黑位堵死、没有雨雾深度。
template: Wide cinematic night view of {RETRO URBAN STREET / NARROW ALLEY}, rain-darkened asphalt and shallow puddles carrying elongated reflections from only {COLOR 1} and {COLOR 2} neon sources, deep layered shopfronts and distant city structures, light rain and restrained steam revealing depth, one small {PARKED CAR / WALKING FIGURE} for scale, nostalgic retro-future atmosphere, readable shadow detail, environment remains the hero, no neon clutter, no random flying cars, no prominent text, no portrait framing.

names: 移轴微缩城市 / Tilt-Shift Miniature City
trigger: 用户需要城市、地标或旅行视觉呈现真实摄影般的玩具尺度、模型感和俯瞰趣味。
not_for: 正交信息图、等距 3D 城市、严肃建筑记录、需要整幅建筑都处于同一焦平面的画面。
visual_dna: 真实城市几何被窄焦平面压缩成微缩模型；道路、桥梁和人流保持可信尺度，选择性清晰区域引导视线，其余区域自然过渡到光学虚化。
composition_light_color_material: 高机位或航拍三分之四视角；窄而连续的对焦带；前后景渐进虚化；暖暮色或蓝调城市灯光；建筑、车辆和人物比例一致。
boundaries: 可替换城市、地标、时间和旅行海报容器；必须保留摄影式透视、窄焦平面、可信城市比例和高机位。等距视图、正交投影或每栋建筑同样清晰属于 3D 微缩图解，不属于此卡。
anti_patterns: 径向后期假模糊、主体也失焦、人物和汽车比例混乱、道路断裂、建筑融化、正交等距视角、把整个城市做成塑料玩具、无意义的大字覆盖地标。
template: High-angle tilt-shift photograph of {CITY OR LANDMARK}, viewed from an elevated three-quarter position, one narrow continuous focus plane crossing {PRIMARY ROAD / BRIDGE / LANDMARK}, foreground and distant skyline falling into gradual optical blur, tiny pedestrians and vehicles at consistent believable scale, warm dusk or blue-hour practical lights, realistic architecture and road connections, playful miniature impression created by optics rather than toy materials, no isometric projection, no radial blur, no warped buildings, no oversized text.

names: 安静奢华柔光棚拍 / Quiet Luxury Studio
trigger: 用户需要克制、可信、松弛的品牌人像、职场人像或时装编辑图。
not_for: 霓虹夜景、强运动、夸张舞台妆、需要喧闹促销感的任务。
visual_dna: 中性色衣物、自然姿态和少量道具；高级感来自人物松弛、衣料垂坠和背景细微色阶。
composition_light_color_material: 眼平，中景或全身；米白、灰褐、炭灰；大窗式柔侧光；羊毛、棉麻、皮革和自然皮肤纹理清楚。
boundaries: 可替换人物、衣装和单件座椅；必须保持低噪声、中性色、自然姿态和柔和方向光。
anti_patterns: 强行奢华布景、皮肤磨平、姿势僵硬、配饰堆砌、背景纯平无层次。
template: Quiet-luxury editorial portrait of {SUBJECT} wearing {SIMPLE TEXTURED OUTFIT}, relaxed asymmetrical pose on {STOOL / CHAIR / BARE STUDIO FLOOR}, seamless {WARM GRAY / IVORY / CHARCOAL} backdrop, broad soft window-like side light, natural skin texture, visible fabric drape, calm direct or off-camera gaze, restrained styling, no glamour props, no plastic skin.

names: 硬影几何时尚 / Graphic Hard-Shadow Fashion
trigger: 用户要求时装图像具有杂志封面式的平面冲击、清晰轮廓和几何影子。
not_for: 柔和生活方式、儿童人像、需要自然环境光连续性的纪实场景。
visual_dna: 人物和硬影共同构成图形；姿势的外轮廓与投影关系比布景复杂度更重要。
composition_light_color_material: 高位或正侧单点硬光；墙面或地面形成明确投影；服装控制在一到两色；可用俯拍强化图形。
boundaries: 可调整视角、背景色和姿态；必须保留单一硬光、可读外轮廓、克制服装和明确影子。
anti_patterns: 多光源冲淡影子、服装花纹过多、手脚与影子粘连、背景杂乱、姿势没有清楚外轮廓。
template: Graphic fashion editorial of {SUBJECT} in {ONE-COLOR SILHOUETTE OUTFIT}, posed to create a clean readable body contour, one hard directional light casting a deliberate geometric shadow onto {WALL / FLOOR}, minimal {COLOR} studio, high contrast with preserved skin detail, composition designed as shape plus shadow, no fill-light clutter, no overlapping limbs.

names: 皮肤优先美妆近景 / Skin-First Beauty
trigger: 用户需要护肤、美妆、首饰或人物面部的高级特写，强调真实皮肤和精确眼神。
not_for: 全身时尚、复杂环境叙事、需要人物动作和场景关系的画面。
visual_dna: 眼神、皮肤微纹理和一个局部妆容或色彩记忆点构成画面，不以配饰数量制造高级感。
composition_light_color_material: 近景或极近景，85mm 感；前侧柔光包裹面部，眼睛必须锐利；肤色自然，妆面只突出一个色域。
boundaries: 可替换妆面、珠宝或植物色素；必须保持眼睛主焦点、真实皮肤、干净背景和克制高光。
anti_patterns: 瓷娃娃皮肤、睫毛和发丝熔化、双眼焦点不一致、珠宝花卉过量、全脸都在发光。
template: Extreme beauty portrait of {SUBJECT}, eyes as the primary focal point, 85mm close framing, broad feathered key light with gentle falloff, real pores, peach fuzz and fine skin variation preserved, one restrained beauty accent {GLOSS / GOLD FLECK / BOTANICAL PIGMENT}, clean background, precise catchlights, no skin smoothing, no over-sharpening, no accessory clutter.

names: 雨夜霓虹电影人像 / Neon Rain Cinematic
trigger: 用户要求都市夜景、音乐视觉、科幻时尚或电影角色人像具有湿润、情绪化的霓虹氛围。
not_for: 真实企业头像、白底证件照、日光生活方式和不允许强色光的肤色广告。
visual_dna: 冷暖双色由环境光源驱动；湿润皮肤、衣料、城市反射和克制情绪共同构成电影感。
composition_light_color_material: 近景或中近景；青蓝环境光加窄洋红边光；背景霓虹化成柔焦色块；脸部暗区保留细节。
boundaries: 可替换城市、工坊和服装；必须保持物理光源逻辑、湿表面响应、深黑层次和单一情绪。
anti_patterns: 面部机械红蓝对半、所有霓虹都清晰、随意增加义体、饱和度顶满、皮肤塑料感。
pilot_note: A directional rainy-neon portrait trial favored this card over a generic rewrite, but restraint varied and the card remains generation-pending.
template: Cinematic night portrait of {SUBJECT} on a rain-darkened {CITY STREET / WORKSHOP}, close to medium framing, cool cyan ambient light and a narrow magenta rim from physically motivated signs, wet skin, hair or leather catching selective highlights, soft neon bokeh behind, emotionally restrained gaze, deep blacks with facial detail, no symmetrical red-blue split, no generic cyber implants.

names: Portra 金色日常 / Analog Golden Lifestyle
trigger: 用户需要咖啡馆、花园、街道、旅行或日常人物呈现自然、亲近、像朋友抓拍的胶片气质。
not_for: 严格棚拍、冷色科技广告、需要极高快门和锐利动作冻结的画面。
visual_dna: 轻微不完美构图、暖肤色、环境空气感和人物正在做的小动作，形成被观察而不是被安排的瞬间。
composition_light_color_material: 35mm 或中画幅模拟；三分构图或轻微倾斜；逆光金边、阴影略青；细颗粒，避免橙色滤镜。
boundaries: 可替换地点、动作和服装；必须保留环境可读性、非居中自然构图、胶片色彩和真实日光方向。
anti_patterns: 每张都正中摆拍、夕阳过曝、全图橙黄、虚假漏光、背景被压成摄影棚。
template: Candid analog lifestyle photograph of {SUBJECT DOING SIMPLE ACTION} at {CAFE / GARDEN / STREET}, late-afternoon backlight, organic off-center framing as if observed rather than posed, Contax and Kodak Portra color response, warm skin with slightly cool shadows, fine natural grain, subtle lens softness at edges, environment still readable, no fake light leaks, no orange wash.

names: 直闪夜生活快照 / Direct-Flash After Hours
trigger: 用户需要便利店、街边餐馆、酒吧或派对时尚图具有生猛、偶然但仍可控的即时感。
not_for: 正式企业肖像、柔和婚礼人像、要求皮肤极度温润的美妆广告。
visual_dna: 机顶硬闪把人物从夜间环境中切出；偶然构图与设计好的姿势、色彩和环境曝光同时存在。
composition_light_color_material: 28–35mm；眼平或虫眼；硬闪近影，环境招牌和实用灯仍可见；皮肤、金属和亮片保留局部高光。
boundaries: 可替换地点、服装和相机角度；必须保留直接闪光、环境曝光、真实皮肤和轻微不完美裁切。
anti_patterns: 把随手拍做成低清图、闪光过曝脸、背景全黑、广角脸严重变形、夜景只剩噪点。
template: After-hours direct-flash fashion snapshot of {SUBJECT} in {CONVENIENCE STORE / STREET CAFE / BAR}, 28-35mm handheld framing, decisive on-camera flash with crisp near shadow, ambient signage and practical lights still visible, slightly imperfect crop and candid posture, real skin and fabric texture, controlled highlight rolloff, no blown face, no empty black background, no artificial motion blur.

names: 黑白雕塑式编辑人像 / Monochrome Sculptural Editorial
trigger: 用户需要时装、艺术家肖像或封面图通过轮廓、留白和灰阶呈现冷静、雕塑般的形体感。
not_for: 依赖彩色产品、节庆氛围、自然日常纪实或需要明确地点色彩的任务。
visual_dna: 黑白用于组织人物、衣物、动物或建筑之间的形体关系，而不是简单去色。
composition_light_color_material: 黑白或极低饱和；一个软主光加窄边光；大面积负空间；黑衣和黑发保留内部褶皱与分离层次。
boundaries: 可替换人物、服装和极简场景；必须保持完整灰阶、清楚轮廓、负空间和材质细节。
anti_patterns: 死黑无细节、简单去色、背景与头发粘连、肤色像灰泥、姿势像证件照。
template: Monochrome sculptural editorial portrait of {SUBJECT}, minimal architectural or seamless setting, body and garment arranged as one strong silhouette, large negative space, soft directional key plus a narrow separation edge, full tonal range from textured blacks to clean highlights, restrained expression, no crushed fabric detail, no flat grayscale conversion, no unnecessary props.

trigger: Destination posters, tourism campaigns, landmark souvenirs, city series and nostalgic print art.
not_for: Factual maps, photoreal travel photography, dense itineraries, modern luxury ads.
visual_dna: One iconic landmark reduced to a heroic silhouette; large sun disc or simple atmospheric field; limited spot colors; screen-printed grain; cream border; civic optimism.
composition_light_color_material: Vertical 2:3 or 3:4; landmark dominates middle; city name occupies a clean bottom band; low-detail supporting skyline; two to four inks such as vermilion, teal, navy, ochre and cream; worn lithographic paper.
boundaries: Use one landmark and one geographic cue. Keep small details subordinate. Generate without wording when the final city label will be typeset later.
template: A vintage mid-century travel poster for [CITY], featuring [ICONIC LANDMARK] as one heroic simplified silhouette against [SUN / SKY / WATER], vertical 2:3 composition, low supporting skyline, limited screen-print palette of [3-4 COLORS], cream paper border, subtle halftone and worn lithographic grain, optimistic civic mood, clean empty title band at the bottom, no invented text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Photographic collage; ten landmarks; modern gradient mesh; tiny itinerary copy; generic suitcase icons; excessive distress that hides the image.

trigger: Architecture exhibitions, city editorials, cultural events, magazine covers and restrained premium travel campaigns.
not_for: Children's art, colorful tourism, action films, information-dense infographics.
visual_dna: Stark black-and-white architectural photograph; strict modular grid; oversized grotesk country heading crossed by elegant display script; coordinates and microcopy used as texture; abundant white field.
composition_light_color_material: Vertical page; one bordered monochrome photo centered or low; large top heading; deliberate asymmetric metadata; deep blacks, white and grey only; subtle newspaper grain.
boundaries: Typography hierarchy has three levels maximum. Use real copy supplied by the user or empty marked zones. One photograph only. Do not decorate with icons beyond small metadata marks.
template: A premium monochrome editorial poster for [CITY / BUILDING], one high-contrast black-and-white architectural photograph inside a strict rectangular frame, oversized bold grotesk heading zone at the top, elegant script-title zone crossing the image, sparse coordinates and microcopy zones aligned to a modular Swiss grid, generous white margins, subtle newspaper grain, vertical print layout, no invented text, no logos.
anti_patterns: Centering every element; colorful accents; multiple photos; fake dense paragraphs; ornamental borders; weak grey contrast.

name_zh: 纪念碑式三维大字海报
trigger: Campaign key visuals, team launches, film-concept posters, motivational themes and event hero banners with one powerful word.
not_for: Paragraph copy, subtle editorial design, small product listings, whimsical illustration.
visual_dna: A single gigantic extruded word acts as architecture; people or characters establish scale; material encodes the concept; mostly white or minimal stage; forward-moving group creates conviction.
composition_light_color_material: Wide 16:9; eye-level centered symmetry; letters fill the rear two-thirds; figures walk toward camera; controlled studio/volumetric light; one concept material such as ember, galaxy, black steel or ice.
boundaries: One short word, ideally 4-8 Latin letters. Spell it exactly and repeat it in a separate typography instruction. One material metaphor only. Keep supporting copy out of generation.
template: A cinematic wide 16:9 campaign poster built around the exact single word "[WORD]" as colossal extruded 3D architecture, letters made from [ONE CONCEPT MATERIAL], a coordinated group of [CHARACTERS] walking toward camera to establish scale, centered eye-level symmetry, clean minimal [WHITE / DARK] stage, controlled rim and volumetric light, premium realistic materials, decisive heroic mood, no other words, no logo.
anti_patterns: Long sentence as sculpture; mixed fire-water-space materials; characters hiding letter shapes; unreadable decorative font; busy background; many slogans.

trigger: Independent posters, zines, editorial illustrations, cultural programs and simple brand graphics that need tactile print energy.
not_for: Photoreal products, subtle skin rendering, exact gradients, glossy luxury imagery or layouts whose small text must already be final.
visual_dna: One to three spot inks plus the paper ground carry the whole image; halftone density creates volume; slight registration drift and paper grain reveal the print process; one bold silhouette or information hierarchy survives at thumbnail size.
composition_light_color_material: One central subject or a clearly divided zine grid; cream or uncoated paper ground; one to three named spot inks; semi-transparent overprint may create secondary colors; shadows are dots, hatching or solid shapes rather than continuous gradients.
boundaries: Preserve the requested subject, palette count and title-safe area. Use one dominant screening logic. Keep registration drift subtle and localized at selected edges, never as general blur. Omit readable text unless the user supplies exact copy. A city-landmark travel layout routes first to `retro-city-travel-poster`; dramatic comic storytelling routes first to `sixties-pop-comic`. Choose this card only when the print process itself is central.
template: A limited-ink risograph editorial illustration of [SUBJECT] for [USE], [ONE BOLD SILHOUETTE / CLEAR ZINE GRID], printed with exactly [INK 1], [INK 2] and optional [INK 3] on warm uncoated paper, form described by solid ink shapes and one consistent halftone screen, subtle paper tooth and slight edge-only registration drift, intentional overprint where colors meet, reserved [TITLE / COPY] area, no gradients, no glossy 3D, no invented text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Rainbow palette; random noise everywhere; photographic blur sold as misregistration; tiny illegible panels; fake vintage stains; mixing screen print, watercolor and chrome.

trigger: Storybook covers, nature scenes, warm campaign illustrations, window displays and simple scenes where physical depth should be immediately legible.
not_for: Literal ecommerce photography, thin vector icons, liquid motion, transparent materials or scenes that depend on realistic hair and skin.
visual_dna: A controlled stack of hand-cut paper planes creates foreground, subject and background; cut edges and cast shadows explain depth; simplified silhouettes and a restrained material palette keep the scene tactile rather than plastic.
composition_light_color_material: Straight-on relief, framed shadowbox or gentle three-quarter diorama; several readable depth bands; one soft directional light; matte fiber paper with visible cut edges; foreground elements frame a clear focal opening.
boundaries: Preserve the requested number of subjects, explicit layer count, colors, safe areas and aspect ratio. Paper remains the dominant material. Keep shadows physically consistent and layer order readable. Route rounded volumetric figures without visible cut planes to `handcrafted-clay-character` instead.
template: A handcrafted layered-papercraft diorama of [SUBJECT AND ACTION], built from [REQUESTED LAYER COUNT / A CONTROLLED STACK OF] clearly separated hand-cut matte paper planes, foreground framing a readable focal opening, visible paper fibers and clean cut edges, soft directional light from [DIRECTION] casting consistent shallow shadows between layers, restrained [PALETTE], [ASPECT RATIO] composition with [SAFE AREA] left open, no plastic, no clay, no floating pieces, no invented text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Hundreds of filigree layers; inconsistent light directions; glossy plastic edges; depth made only with blur; crowded decorative animals; mixed clay, fabric and paper; paper characters with realistic human skin.

trigger: Poetic landscapes, animals, plants, tea objects and contemplative editorial images where restraint and brush rhythm matter more than literal detail.
not_for: Accurate diagrams, busy narrative scenes, colorful commercial packaging, photoreal portraits or requests that require crisp uniform linework.
visual_dna: A few expressive strokes define the subject while untouched paper carries atmosphere; dry and wet ink, dark mass and pale wash, precise mark and dissolving edge form a controlled rhythm.
composition_light_color_material: Asymmetric subject placement; more than half the field may remain untouched; black ink with optional one muted mineral accent; absorbent paper; depth comes from ink value and edge moisture, not perspective haze effects.
boundaries: Preserve explicit prohibitions on calligraphy, seals and accent color. Use the fewest marks that keep the subject recognizable. One focal ink mass anchors the composition.
template: A minimalist [CHINESE INK WASH / SUMI-E] painting of [SUBJECT] in [SETTING], asymmetric composition with expansive untouched warm-white paper, a few confident brush strokes and pale wet-ink washes, controlled dry-brush texture at [FOCAL DETAIL], depth expressed through ink value and dissolving edges, poetic restraint, [OPTIONAL SINGLE MUTED ACCENT], no decorative border, no invented calligraphy, no seal stamp unless requested, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Filling every empty area; uniform digital outlines; automatic red seal or poem; gray fog over the entire image; random splatter; combining watercolor rainbow washes with monochrome ink logic.

trigger: Portraits, still lifes and landscapes that need physical paint, decisive motion and emotionally amplified light while the subject remains recognizable.
not_for: Flat brand graphics, precise technical illustration, delicate watercolor, clean vector art or abstract vortex covers already covered by `psychedelic-abstract-cover`.
visual_dna: Thick palette-knife ridges follow the subject's form and movement; large value masses establish readability before detail; a restrained warm-cool opposition gives the paint a reason to catch light.
composition_light_color_material: One dominant subject or natural force; medium or large brush groupings; optional glimpses of canvas at selected edges; directional light catches raised paint; one dominant color temperature with one or two counter-accents.
boundaries: Preserve anatomy or scene structure beneath the brushwork. Put the thickest paint at the focal plane. Let background strokes simplify rather than compete. Use one coherent light direction.
template: An expressive figurative impasto oil painting of [SUBJECT] in [SETTING], recognizable structure established with large value masses, thick palette-knife ridges and loaded brushstrokes following [FORM / MOTION], strongest paint buildup at [FOCAL AREA], directional [LIGHT] catching the raised pigment, restrained warm-cool palette of [THREE COLOR FAMILIES], selected raw-canvas edges and simplified background, tactile physical oil paint, no smooth airbrush, no uniform texture, no photographic depth-of-field, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Equal texture on every surface; anatomy dissolved into paint noise; rainbow color with no hierarchy; digitally embossed filter; tiny decorative strokes; copying a named living artist; mixing literal 3D objects into the canvas.

names: 暗黑元素奢侈品 / Elemental Dark Luxury
trigger: 用户要求香氛、酒、护肤、饮料或精密产品呈现克制、深色、电影式的高级广告质感。
not_for: 电商白底主图、童趣产品、需要完整说明书或多 SKU 对比的画面。
selection_boundary: 若用户只要求“纯黑背景、瓶子清楚”，先给克制的黑色棚拍方案；湿石、水或烟雾属于需要用户明确选择的环境隐喻，不应自动添加。
visual_dna: 单一英雄产品从水、湿石、烟雾或琥珀液体中浮现；环境只表达一种材质隐喻，产品身份始终清楚。
composition_light_color_material: 4:5；产品占画面约 45–60%；低机位或轻微斜置；黑底配单一暖金或冷蓝边缘光；玻璃、湿石、磨砂金属保留物理反射和微瑕疵。
boundaries: 可替换产品、元素介质和单一强调色；必须保持一个英雄产品、一种视觉隐喻、低键光和可读的产品轮廓。
anti_patterns: 堆满花果、廉价金光、标签变形、多个产品抢主体、黑位堵死、粒子覆盖产品。
pilot_note: A clean-black perfume trial favored the simpler studio direction. Do not add the elemental environment unless the user selects that richer option; this card remains generation-pending.
template: 4:5 premium product campaign for {PRODUCT}, one hero object emerging from {WET ROCK / DARK WATER / AMBER LIQUID}, low-key black environment, one controlled {WARM GOLD / COOL BLUE} rim light, physically accurate glass, metal and material reflections, sparse atmospheric haze, restrained luxury, product occupies 55% of frame, sharp label area, no extra products, no fake text, no logo unless supplied.

names: 白色画廊高键产品 / White Gallery High-Key
trigger: 用户要求护肤、香水、珠宝等产品干净、可信、留白充分，接近画廊陈列或高端电商广告。
not_for: 需要强情绪夜景、动态爆炸、复杂场景叙事的广告。
visual_dna: 白色空间由石材、手部、柔影或珠宝切面建立层次，不靠装饰堆砌制造高级感。
composition_light_color_material: 居中或三分构图；白、象牙、浅灰；大面积柔光和细窄接触阴影；透明玻璃、皮肤、石材和贵金属边缘清晰。
boundaries: 可变更承托物与轻量辅助元素；必须保持高键、低噪声、真实接触关系和大面积负空间。
anti_patterns: 纯白过曝、产品漂浮无接触、廉价塑料感、花瓣或蝴蝶喧宾夺主、文字乱码。
template: Minimal high-key gallery product photograph of {PRODUCT}, clean white-to-ivory seamless space, placed on {PALE STONE / PRECISE HAND POSE / SIMPLE PLINTH}, soft large-source light from upper left, delicate contact shadow, accurate translucent and metallic edges, generous negative space, quiet premium mood, no decorative clutter, no text or branding unless provided.

names: 动态液体爆破 / Kinetic Splash
trigger: 用户要求饮料、果味食品或清洁产品具有新鲜、能量、速度和社交广告冲击力。
not_for: 奢侈品静物、严肃医疗产品、需要安静可信感的电商主图。
visual_dna: 冻结一个可读的动作瞬间；液体和原料沿统一轨迹围绕产品运动，而不是随机爆炸。
composition_light_color_material: 产品稳定居中；液体形成 S 形、环形或冠状；高快门硬边配液滴背光；色彩来自口味，背景只用一到两种对比色。
boundaries: 可替换液体、配料和轨迹；必须保留稳定英雄产品、单一运动方向、可读包装和可信黏度。
anti_patterns: 泥状液体、随机水果雨、包装被遮住、卡通泡沫、脏乱飞溅、所有元素同等清晰。
template: High-speed commercial shot of {BEVERAGE OR FOOD PRODUCT}, stable centered hero, one coherent {ARC / S-CURVE / CROWN} splash describing motion around, not over, the package, only {2-3 INGREDIENTS} in controlled trajectories, crisp backlit droplets, saturated flavor color against {CONTRAST BACKGROUND}, realistic viscosity and condensation, label unobstructed, no random debris, no fake typography.

trigger: 用户希望产品广告有一个清楚、能一句话说完的超现实视觉隐喻。
not_for: 精确电商展示、结构说明、必须完全写实的合规广告。
visual_dna: 产品尺度或结构变成一个微型世界；微型人物和环境只提供尺度，产品仍能被立即识别。
composition_light_color_material: 中心视觉清晰；微型人物低权重；现实产品材质与超现实环境无缝连接；全画面只有一个统一光源。
boundaries: 可替换产品和隐喻；必须只有一个核心概念，并保持产品轮廓、材质与品牌区域完整。
anti_patterns: 同时讲多个概念、玩具模型感、人物过多、产品身份消失、明显拼贴接缝。
template: Surreal premium campaign where {PRODUCT} literally becomes {ONE VISUAL METAPHOR}, product identity and silhouette remain instantly readable, tiny environmental details provide scale, seamless transition between real product materials and the imagined world, single light direction, cinematic depth, one clear idea only, no collage seams, no unrelated props, no explanatory text.

names: 爆炸结构与切面剧场 / Exploded Identity
trigger: 用户需要解释产品内部结构、设计秩序或性能，把技术信息做成高级广告。
not_for: 没有明确结构的软性产品、人物肖像、只要求氛围而不关心工程可信度的画面。
visual_dna: 拆解解释功能和层级；零件沿明确工程轴排列，核心部件是最高视觉对比。
composition_light_color_material: 正交或轻微三分之四视角；白底偏技术说明，黑底偏高级广告；零件间距均匀，材料区分准确。
boundaries: 可在爆炸图和切面舞台之间选择；必须保持轴线、零件层级、原产品轮廓和结构可信性。
anti_patterns: 随机炸飞零件、机械结构错误、主体轮廓不可辨、部件间距混乱、注释乱码。
template: Precision exploded-view campaign of {PRODUCT}, outer shell and functional components separated along one clear engineering axis, exact alignment and believable part hierarchy, hero core highlighted, {WHITE TECHNICAL STUDIO / BLACK PREMIUM STAGE}, orthographic three-quarter view, controlled spacing, material-accurate metal, plastic and glass, no random fragments, no illegible annotations.

names: 午夜高性能汽车 / Midnight Performance Automotive
trigger: 用户要求跑车、摩托或交通工具呈现性能、阶层感和电影式夜景广告。
not_for: 二手车记录照、家庭生活方式汽车图、需要展示全套内饰功能的目录页。
visual_dna: 车身轮廓、地面接触、连续曲面反射与环境尺度共同表达性能，不依赖过量霓虹。
composition_light_color_material: 低机位三分之四前视；车占 55–70%；冷蓝夜景配少量暖光，或纯白设计实验室；轮胎必须接地。
boundaries: 可替换夜港、湿路、实验室；必须保留真实车辆几何、连续车漆高光、地面接触和单一英雄车辆。
anti_patterns: 车辆漂浮、轮毂变形、雨夜霓虹过量、环境抢主体、海报文字压住车身。
template: Premium automotive campaign for {VEHICLE}, low three-quarter hero angle, body fills 65% of frame, grounded tires and physically continuous reflections across painted metal, {MIDNIGHT HARBOR / WET MOUNTAIN ROAD / WHITE DESIGN LAB}, restrained cool palette with one warm accent, believable scale and road contact, no motion-streak clutter, no fake badge or typography.

names: 微距机械与贵金属 / Precision Macro Horology
trigger: 用户希望手表、珠宝、相机或精密器件通过结构精度和真实材料表现高级感。
not_for: 需要完整产品全貌、多人生活方式、低成本促销海报的任务。
visual_dna: 高级感来自机械精度、表面纹理与受控反射，焦点只落在一个最重要的结构或连接处。
composition_light_color_material: 微距或极近景；浅而可信的焦平面；侧光揭示拉丝、抛光、宝石切面、皮革颗粒和微小使用痕迹。
boundaries: 可替换精密对象和重点结构；必须保持精确几何、物理景深、克制配色和可读材质差异。
anti_patterns: 全画面锐利、宝石塑料感、机械齿轮不咬合、镜面爆白、后期假糊、装饰性假齿轮。
template: Extreme macro product portrait of {WATCH / JEWELRY / PRECISION OBJECT}, focus locked on {KEY MECHANISM / GEM FACET / MATERIAL JOIN}, shallow but physically plausible depth of field, narrow side light revealing brushed metal, polished edges and microscopic imperfections, restrained charcoal-and-{ACCENT} palette, exact geometry, no decorative fantasy gears, no blown highlights.

trigger: Boss arenas, dark mythology, techno-religious civilizations, game key art, monumental antagonist reveals.
not_for: Cozy fantasy, clean science education, light adventure, small character portraits.
visual_dna: Sacred axial architecture fused with machinery; colossal seated or haloed entities; one tiny pilgrim/hero supplies scale; repeated circles, chains, ribs and circuitry establish ritual order; metal, bone ceramic and stone feel ancient and functional.
composition_light_color_material: Ultra-wide or 16:9; strict symmetry or near-symmetry; low camera; foreground lone figure, midground stairs, background deities; black iron, oxidized bronze, bone and sparse cobalt/plasma; backlight, halo light and volumetric dust.
boundaries: One civilization and one ritual. Keep the scale ladder readable. Ornament must follow a repeated construction logic. Reserve the brightest light for the sacred/hostile focal point.
template: A monumental dark techno-mythic cathedral where [ANCIENT MYTH / RITUAL] is engineered through [MACHINE SYSTEM], colossal [DEITIES / MACHINE SAINTS] enthroned along a strict axial hierarchy, one tiny [HERO / PILGRIM] in the foreground for scale, low wide camera, repeated halos chains ribs and circuitry, corroded black iron oxidized bronze bone ceramic and worn stone, sparse [COBALT / RED PLASMA] light, deep shadow and volumetric dust, cinematic AAA concept art, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Random gears; every surface equally detailed; ten unrelated religions; bright rainbow magic; close-up without scale; generic gothic church with robots pasted in.

trigger: Worldbuilding thumbnails, strategy-game regions, whimsical settlements, theme-park maps and collectible dioramas.
not_for: Realistic urban planning, first-person action, empty landscapes, flat icons.
visual_dna: A self-contained island with a visible edge and readable biome; one oversized landmark organizes smaller functional buildings; roads and water form a traversal loop; miniature citizens imply activity; tilt-shift scale model clarity.
composition_light_color_material: 30-45 degree high-angle view; island centered against sky/void; deep focus across settlement with mild miniature falloff; warm sunset or bright daylight; stone, timber, copper, water and vegetation; stylized 3D game render.
boundaries: Every building needs a role. Maintain one theme. Show entrance, path network and destination. Do not hide geography under props or labels.
template: A premium stylized 3D isometric floating miniature world themed around [WORLD FUNCTION], a self-contained [ROCK / ISLAND / PLATFORM] with one oversized [LANDMARK], several smaller functional buildings, visible paths bridges water and working areas forming a readable traversal loop, tiny inhabitants for scale, 35-degree high-angle camera, deep environmental clarity with gentle tilt-shift, [GOLDEN-HOUR / BRIGHT-DAY] volumetric light, cohesive stone timber metal and vegetation materials, polished strategy-game concept art, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Random building scatter; no island edge; landmark same size as huts; unreadable maze; unrelated biomes; excessive labels embedded in image.

name_zh: 温馨复古像素游戏资产
trigger: Farming RPG tilesets, inventory icons, cozy food sprites, village props and production-ready 2D asset sheets.
not_for: Painterly concept art, photoreal food, first-person shooters, high-resolution UI mockups.
visual_dna: Deliberate pixel clusters rather than a pixelation filter; 3/4 top-down or isolated icon view; compact warm palette; bright edge highlights; consistent outline weight; each asset fits one tile logic.
composition_light_color_material: White/transparent-looking sheet with aligned rows for assets, or one centered icon; no smooth gradients; light from upper left; warm brown, cream, leaf green and fruit accents; 16/32-bit readable resolution.
boundaries: Declare a base tile size and perspective once. Keep scale and light direction identical. Separate sprite, shadow and background. Use no anti-aliasing.
template: A cohesive cozy retro pixel-art [ASSET SHEET / SINGLE ICON] for a top-down farming RPG, [ASSET LIST], consistent [32x32 / 48x48] tile logic and three-quarter view, deliberate pixel clusters, crisp one-pixel dark outlines, upper-left lighting, compact warm palette of cream wood-brown leaf-green and [ACCENT], simple contact shadows, evenly spaced on a clean white background, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Downscaled smooth illustration; mixed perspectives; random pixel sizes; airbrushed shading; outline thickness changing per object; overlapping assets.

name_zh: 赛博朋克雨夜黑色都市
trigger: Futuristic alleys, dystopian city posters, noir characters, neon markets, urban sci-fi key art.
not_for: Clean utopia, daylight solarpunk, minimal technology diagrams, product-only renders.
visual_dna: A believable dense city first, neon second; layered street, elevated transit and tower strata; rain turns signage into reflections; one human silhouette or traffic stream supplies narrative scale; cyan/red or cyan/magenta opposition.
composition_light_color_material: Street-level wide or vertical low angle; wet road occupies meaningful foreground; deep perspective; low-key night, rain and volumetric haze; dark concrete, glass, cables and restrained emissive signage.
boundaries: Limit neon to two dominant hues plus practical white. Preserve dark surfaces. Make signage blocks plausible but not readable. Include one path the eye can follow.
template: A cinematic cyberpunk rain-noir scene in [CITY TYPE], street-level [WIDE / VERTICAL LOW-ANGLE] view with a clear path into dense layered architecture, wet asphalt occupying the foreground and reflecting restrained [CYAN + RED / CYAN + MAGENTA] signage, elevated transit and distant towers fading into rain haze, one [LONE FIGURE / TRAFFIC STREAM] for scale, dark concrete glass and cable detail, low-key volumetric light, believable lived-in city, no readable text, no logo.
anti_patterns: Neon on every edge; dry street; floating holograms with no infrastructure; empty generic skyline; illegible text wall; crushed blacks with no material detail.
